Method of Attack: Abuse of 'DisableAntiSpyware' group policy to disable antivirus protection in Windows; Adding 'DisableAntiSpyware' Registry value to disable Microsoft Defender and third-party antivirus software; Running malware unchecked by Microsoft Defender or other security software
Impacted Systems: Windows 10 versions prior to 1903 using Microsoft Defender Antivirus
Attack Vector: Registry modification via 'DisableAntiSpyware' value; Group policy abuse
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of 'DisableAntiSpyware' Registry value set to 1 under HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender
